title: Murray 2005 auditory–somatosensory alignment
citation: Murray, M. M., Molholm, S., Michel, C. M., Heslenfeld, D. J., Ritter, W., Javitt, D. C., Schroeder, C. E., & Foxe, J. J. (2005). Grabbing your ear: Rapid auditory–somatosensory multisensory interactions in low-level sensory cortices are not constrained by stimulus alignment. Cerebral Cortex, 15(7), 963–974.
notes: Inspection schedule for the eight static left/right stimulus configurations and minimum session length. The software uses stereo noise and nominal timing markers. Research launch requires the original two-speaker and two-vibrator setup, right-foot pedal, calibrated timing and synchronized EEG.

auditory_stimulus.placement: One beside each hand, approximately 100° apart in azimuth.

tactile_stimulus.site: One held between thumb and index finger of each hand, away from the knuckles.

trial_schedule.order: All eight configurations intermixed randomly with equal counts within each block.

response.task: Press a right-foot pedal as quickly as possible on detection of any auditory, tactile or combined event. Avoid anticipating.

pretask_audibility_and_localization.scope: Before testing, confirm the left and right loudspeaker sounds are clearly audible, including with earplugs, and that the participant can identify the emitting speaker.
pretask_audibility_and_localization.reported_result: All participants could readily localize either speaker.

analysis.reaction_time: Within-participant comparisons of each pairing against single modalities, aligned against misaligned, plus Miller race-model inequality using matched single-modality RT distributions.
analysis.erp: Compare each audio-somatosensory ERP against the algebraic sum of its side-matched auditory and somatosensory ERPs, then compare aligned and misaligned combinations.

preview_scope.schedule: One software participant with 25 blocks. Each block has 48 nominal simultaneous pairs, 24 single-modality auditory trials and 24 single-modality tactile trial markers. Toolkit Baseline denotes tactile-only stimulation here.
preview_scope.sound: Stationary synthetic 30 ms white noise sent to separate stereo channels. The software uses 5 ms ramps. Channel hard-panning is a preview routing choice; it supplies no physical angle, level or binaural cue.
preview_scope.timing: Within-block random lists are seeded. Physical interstimulus spacing, pedal capture and acquisition trigger timing remain outside the preview.

implementation_gaps: Calibrated two-speaker and two-vibrator scheduler and EEG synchronization are required for the simultaneous stimulus timings.
The original sound file, output calibration, exact audio source coordinates, vibrator acceleration, trigger timing, interstimulus anchor and actual recorded block counts are unavailable.

Research response capture requires the right-foot pedal and trigger-relative reaction times. Published EEG acquisition and race-model/ERP scoring require validated synchronized acquisition and preprocessing.

provenance.field: Cohorts, stimuli, pre-task checks, eight configurations, intervals and detection response
provenance.source: https://doi.org/10.1093/cercor/bhh197, p. 965, Subjects, Stimuli and Task, and Fig. 1.
